comment: Everything the scan depends on is pinned here. Changing a pin changes what 'clean' means, so bump them deliberately and re-baseline. Download hashes are verified before use; a mismatch aborts the scan.

php.note: Major.minor of the PHP binary that runs WP-CLI and WordPress. The exact version is recorded in every report.

runtime_canary.note: A generated synthetic plugin that must trigger this runtime-check finding. If it does not, runtime checks did not run and the scan is reported as failed.
